title: factory-verifier-failure
description: Strict structured record of one deterministic verifier failure (FACTORY-LOOP-SPEC section 19; EVID-02). The trusted control plane mints it when a deterministic verification/acceptance command fails or cannot be trusted, and it is the structured-handoff foundation for the implementer-owned inspect/edit/test/diagnose loop. Every string is data: the exact command is an argv record of what the trusted control plane invoked, never an executable path/argv authority, and no consumer may re-execute it from this artifact. Sizes are bounded, enums are closed, and duplicate JSON keys are rejected at parse time.

commit.description: Exact 40-hex commit the verifier ran at; a stale or forged commit fails closed.

command.description: Exact command as data (argv record of what the trusted control plane invoked), never an executable path/argv authority.

exit_status.description: Exact exit status of the verifier (negative for signal/termination statuses).

expected.description: The expected outcome (for example exit 0 with a clean tree).

observed.description: The observed outcome (for example exit 1 with a dirty tree).

output_tail.description: Bounded relevant output tail of the failing verifier (bounded size; never a full transcript).

output_ref.description: Bounded reference to an already-produced bounded output artifact; never an executable path.

changed_files.description: Repository-relative paths changed by the failing attempt (bounded).

artifact_refs.description: Bounded references to evidence artifacts produced by the attempt; never executable paths.

environment_classification.description: Closed classification of the environment at failure time: clean tree, dirty tree, foreign artifacts, or unavailable environment.

capability_classification.description: Closed classification of the declared-capability state at failure time.

rerun_scope.description: Closed rerun scope: full rerun, targeted rerun, or no rerun.
